cp24:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Kāsīnaṃ puravar' uttame bhaginī bhātaro satta nibbattā sotthiye kule. || ||
cp24:2.1: Etesaṃ pubbajo āsiṃ hirisukka-m-upāgato bhavaṃ disvāna bhayato nekkhammābhirato ahaṃ. || ||
cp24:3.1: Mātāpitūhi pahitā sahāyā ekamānasā kāmehi maṃ nimantenti: kulavaṃsaṃ dharehi ti. || ||
cp24:4.1: Yaṃ tesaṃ vacanaṃ vuttaṃ gihīdhamme sukhāvahaṃ tam-me ahosi kaṭhinaṃ tattaphālasamaṃ viya. || ||
cp24:5.1: Te maṃ tadā ukkhipantaṃ pucchiṃsu patthitaṃ mama: kiṃ tvaṃ patthayasi samma yadi kāme na bhuñjasi. || ||
cp24:6.1: Tes' āhaṃ evam-avacaṃ attakāmo hitesinaṃ: nāhaṃ patthemi gihībhāvaṃ nekkhammābhirato ahaṃ. || ||
cp24:7.1: Te mayhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā pitu mātu ca sāvayuṃ mātā pitā evam-āhu: sabbe va pabbajāma bho. || ||
cp24:8.1: Ubho mātā pitā mayhaṃ bhaginū ca satta bhātaro amitadhanaṃ chaḍḍayitvā pavisimhā mahāvanan-ti. || ||
